It doesn’t feel like a choice anymore. If I don’t do it “right,” I get this intense anxiety, like something terrible will happen to my body. I’ll stand in front of the mirror and check my stomach and thighs over and over, or weigh myself multiple times a day.  

Even when I’m arranging my plate, I need the food to be divided perfectly, like the vegetables on one side and protein on the other, in straight lines. It has to look exact and even or I feel really uncomfortable and can’t bring myself to start eating. But this need for things to be “just right” is really only around food and my body—my desk at school, my apartment, my clothes, they can be messy and it doesn’t bother me much.
